name: Smoked Colombian Chorizo
description: Authentic artisan pork sausage cured with raw garlic, scallions, and traditional spices, slow-smoked over sweet hickory wood.

name: Smoked Butifarra Bites
description: Traditional seasoned ground pork globes, cold-cured and hot-smoked with native oak logs for a distinct coastal bite.

name: Artisanal Smoked Morcilla
description: Delicate blood sausage prepared with jasmine rice, fresh herbs, and slow-roasted over mild applewood smoke.

name: Coffee-Rubbed Beef Ribs
description: Premium beef short ribs crusted in custom Colombian espresso grinds, brown sugar, and slow-smoked for half a day.

name: Panela-Glazed Pork Belly
description: Thick cuts of premium pork belly marinated in natural sugar cane juice (panela) and smoked to a mahogany bark.

name: Heritage Smoked Chicken
description: Whole free-range chicken wet-brined in dark artisan lager and local spices, hot-smoked to absolute tenderness.

name: Applewood Smoked Trout
description: Fresh mountain lake trout fillets, cured with lime zest and sea salt, gently smoked to preserve its clean profile.

name: Citrus-Cured Smoked Salmon
description: Premium Atlantic salmon fillets bathed in citrus oil and orange essence, then cold-smoked over natural alderwood.

name: Smoked Sea Salt Crystals
description: Coarse Pacific sea salt slow-roasted inside our main smokehouses to capture rich wood smoke aroma.

name: Smoked Andean Aji Sauce
description: Medium heat green peppers and scallions fire-roasted and emulsified with cold-pressed olive oils.

name: Smoked Queso Campesino
description: Traditional Colombian fresh cheese lightly surface-salted and smoked for a rich crust and buttery interior.

name: Smoked Chimichurri Rub
description: Dry spice rub containing dehydrated parsley, garlic, smoked paprika, and coarse herbs.

name: Smoked Colombian Coffee
description: Unique single-origin dark roast coffee beans exposed briefly to sweet smoke notes during roasting.

name: Traditional Smokehouse Box
description: Curated selection containing chorizo, bacon, ribs, smoked salt, and a bottle of our signature dry rub.

name: Colombian Sampler Pack
description: Taste the complete standard selection with mini portions of Colombian chorizo, morcilla, and local smoked cheese.
